{{Quote|The cost of replacing lasers at the yard is ridiculous, but I suppose it's worth it.|Zia Woog|<ref name="XWA" />}}
'''Zia Woog''' worked in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic's]] [[Accountant/Legends|accounting]] department during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. [[Rebel pilot/Legends|Rebel pilots]] at that [[Time/Legends|time]] frequently tested themselves in the unofficial "[[pilot proving grounds]]," competing to set the best time on a series of courses through a Rebel [[Salvage Yard|salvage yard]] hidden in an [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid field]]. Woog had concerns about the cost of replacing [[Laser/Legends|lasers]] damaged by the [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]], but considered it worth it to improve their skills.<ref name="XWA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Zia Woog was created for the [[1999]] [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance]]''. When launching the pilot proving grounds, several quotes are shown on the screen. A quote from Woog is included among them in the mission file, but is not shown in the game itself.
